title: Because I was tired
goal: Give reasons with -DIğI için, apologize and thank with it, and say because of and thanks to: yüzünden, sayesinde.

intro.text: **Because** is `-DIk` + a possessive + *için*, before the result: *Hasta olduğum için gelemedim* (I couldn't come because I was ill). It's how you apologize and thank: *Geç kaldığım için özür dilerim*, *Yardım ettiğin için teşekkür ederim*.

vocab.en: to be embarrassed, to be ashamed

exercises.label: *yorgun olmak* + `-DIğI için`: because I'm tired, because you're tired…
exercises.explain: *ol-duğ-* + the possessive, then *için*. The k softens before a vowel (*olduğum*) and stays before *-ları* (*oldukları*).

exercises.question: How do you say **I came because I missed you**?

why.1: *Özlemek için* is **in order to miss you**: `-mAk için` gives a purpose. A reason takes `-DIğI için`.
why.2: *Özlediğin* is **you missed**: the ending names the person.

exercises.explain: *özle-diğ-im için*: **because I missed**. The reason comes first.

reject.why: *Geç kalmak için* would be **in order to be late**. A reason takes `-DIğI için`: *geç kaldığım için*.
*Kaldığın* is **you** were late. You're apologizing for yourself: *kaldığım*.

exercises.explain: *kal-dığ-ım için*: **because I'm late**, the everyday way to apologize for it.

exercises.prompt: We didn't go out because it was raining.

reject.why: `-mAk için` is a purpose. For a reason, use `-DIğI için`: *yağdığı için*.

exercises.en: I couldn't come because I was ill.

accept: I was late for the meeting because of the traffic.
I was late for the meeting because of traffic.
Because of (the) traffic, I was late for the meeting.
I [arrived|got] late to the meeting because of (the) traffic.
I got to the meeting late because of (the) traffic.
The traffic made me late for the meeting.

exercises.en: We found the way thanks to you.
exercises.explain: *Sayesinde* is a possessed noun, so it follows the owner: *benim sayemde*, *senin sayende*, *onun sayesinde*.

exercises.text: Bana yardım ettiğin için teşekkür ederim.
accept: Bana yardım ettiğiniz için teşekkür ederim.

exercises.question: *Yarın sınavı olduğu için Elif bütün gün çalıştı.* Why did Elif study all day?
exercises.explain: *Sınavı olduğu için*: **because she has an exam**. Inside the clause, *var* becomes *olduğu*.

exercises.prompt: I'm embarrassed because I forgot your name.

reject.why: `-mAk için` is **in order to**. For a reason, use `-DIğI için`: *unuttuğum için*.

accept: I cannot go on holiday because I do not have any money.
I cannot go on [holiday|vacation] because I [do not have|have no] money.
I cannot go on vacation because I do not have any money.
I am not able to go on [holiday|vacation] because I [do not have any|do not have|have no] money.
Because I [do not have any|do not have|have no] money, I [cannot|am not able to] go on [holiday|vacation].
I [do not have any|do not have|have no] money, so I [cannot|am not able to] go on [holiday|vacation].
What is the reason you are late?
What is the reason [you were late|for your being late|for you being late|for being late]?
